name: cost_collapse
headline: Accuracy parity with grep, but navigation COST collapses. Compiler-precise navigation makes an agent meaningfully cheaper to run on big code.
honest_framing: This is NOT 'finds bugs grep can't'. Both arms hit on every task (accuracy parity). The measured win is efficiency that grows with codebase size: fewer tool-uses (and tokens) to reach the same answer. Cross-project case: grep 16 tool-uses -> graph 4.
